132.literal: Until I can be sure nobody's watching me...
132.official: I can't risk gettin' close till I'm damn sure nobody's followin' me.

133.literal: It'd be a shame to make her eat cold ones like these.
133.official: I ain't about to make her eat my cold leftovers.

135.literal: A guest in the hall would like to speak with the manager.
135.official: A guest in the main hall has asked to speak with you, sir.

136.literal: He's short... and looks a bit worn out.
136.official: Rather short, and... There's no word for it but ragged.

137.literal: Hey, tell me what you want before you get drunk.
137.official: Whoa, how about you state yer business before gettin' completely wasted?

138.literal: Ah! Right, right! I came here on an errand for Lee-san.
138.official: Ah! That right! I came with message from Lee-san.

139.literal: So I was asked to deliver a message.

140.literal: So you're sayin' he wants to track down where I live...?
140.official: What, he wants to get a bead on where I live?

141.literal: So generous, just as I thought. Manager-san, I love you!
141.official: Such big man! I love generous Manager-san!

142.literal: No, if anything, things just keep getting worse.
142.official: If anything, things're worse now than before.

143.literal: If Sagawa gets wind that I saved the girl, I'm finished.
143.official: Jig's up as soon as Sagawa finds out I'm keeping the girl alive.

144.literal: The girls who belong to your club can be scouted around town, or...
144.official: You can add new girls to the club roster by scouting talent around Sotenbori,

145.literal: With only a few girls, it will be difficult to make your club able to beat rival clubs.
145.official: It'll be hard to outperform the competition with an empty roster.

146.literal: Steadily plugging away at business is fine, but...
146.official: And word-of-mouth from everyday business is one way to bring in new customers, but...

147.literal: I hear partnering with shops around town is good, too.
147.official: I hear signing deals with other local businesses is also effective.

148.literal: In Sotenbori, there are shops that will enter into a partnership with you if you pay them.
148.official: Some of Sotenbori's shops will sign partnership deals with you, for a price.

149.literal: When you find a good shop, actively try to form a partnership with it.
149.official: Sign deals with any hot spots you find!

150.literal: So there's a lot to do besides running the club, huh.
150.official: Looks like I'm gonna be busy outside the club, too.

151.literal: That's right. Outside the club and inside, it's a battlefield!
151.official: Absolutely. The whole city's our battleground!

152.literal: Man, this club really doesn't have many girls working, though.
152.official: This place REALLY needs more girls.

153.literal: It should be fine to bring the other girls over to this club.
153.official: Should be fine if I bring the rest over here.

154.literal: Getting right to it, I've come to hear your decision, as promised.
154.official: I'm here for your answer, as promised.

155.literal: I wanted to settle this peacefully. What a shame.
155.official: ...I see. And I was so hoping to do this amicably. Shame.

157.literal: Certainly, rather than the incompetent Youda continuing to run the club...
157.official: I'll grant you, it's a wiser choice than letting a dimwit like Youda keep running this dunghill into the ground.

158.literal: Besides, he seems like a man who's quite used to fighting...
158.official: And you seem like you know your way around a fight...

159.literal: No... how these guys are going to struggle along...
159.official: No... I find myself curious to see how they plan to claw their way out of this hole.

160.literal: Having made enemies of the Five Stars...
160.official: ...just how far you manage to crawl after making enemies of the Five Stars.

161.literal: Why don't I just sit back and watch from on high?
161.official: I look forward to being entertained as I watch...

162.literal: You got off with your lives, Youda-san. And you too, Majima-san.
162.official: You were lucky today, Youda-san. And Majima-san?

163.literal: Whenever I feel like it... I'll come and crush you.
163.official: If I get bored, I'll drop by and swat you down like the flies you are.

164.literal: I'm gonna smash it to pieces. ...You're the one who'd better brace yourself.
164.official: Enjoy watchin' your wobbly little house of cards come crumbling down on top of ya. Hope yer ass is ready to get buried.

165.literal: I've got my main job to deal with too, so...
165.official: I've got my hands full with my own place too,

166.literal: I can't be here looking after things all the time, but...
166.official: so I can't be here around the clock.

167.literal: I'll try to drop by often whenever I've got free time.
167.official: I'll make a point to drop by whenever I get a minute, though.

168.literal: Huh. So this is the backyard?

169.literal: All sorts of things related to the club, managing the girls, and so on...
169.official: I organize things back here, manage the girls, that sort of thing.

170.literal: Yes. You seem to have a proven track record, too...
170.official: Yes, sir. You certainly have the experience,

171.literal: ...is what I think. I want to entrust you with full authority, Majima-san.

172.literal: I'll make up my mind, too. Leave it to me.
172.official: ...Yeah, alright. If you're that serious about this, I'll do my part, too. Leave it to me.

173.official: Heh... Feels a little weird hearin' that from you.

174.literal: Though there are only three of us, including me...
174.official: See... there's only three of us working here, including me.

175.literal: No wonder the place is so dead...
175.official: Explains why the place is a ghost town, though.

176.literal: The popular [clubs] that have Sotenbori's cabaret clubs under their thumb...
176.official: There are five cabaret clubs in town that have muscled out all the rest.

177.literal: ...Ever since they opened clubs in Sotenbori,
177.official: But ever since those five set up shop here,

178.literal: [the other clubs] have been driven out of business one after another.
178.official: All the other clubs have had to shut down.

179.literal: Please, enough with the harassment already!
179.official: I've had all the harassment from you I can take!

180.literal: Making prank calls every single day, from morning till night,
180.official: Crank calling us day in and day out,

181.literal: [proof] that we're the ones carrying out this harassment...
181.official: Just where is your proof that I'm behind any of this alleged harassment?

182.literal: ...it's a club that has a monopoly [on the customers], and it's nearby...
182.official: Mars basically has a monopoly on the customers in this part of town.

183.literal: ...However, if you keep defying us, that's another story.
183.official: But if you continue to defy us, the terms of this little reward are gonna be quite a bit different.

184.literal: Heh heh... For a grimy dump like this...
184.official: Heh heh... Honestly, I'm offering to pay money for a trash pile like this.

185.official: How many hard working men and women have the five of you vultures put out of this line of work now?

186.literal: Heh... Just what you'd expect from a club that was once popular...
186.official: Heh... I suppose that's the mark of a man running the once-popular Sunshine.

187.official: Very well. I'll leave it at that for today.

188.literal: My, I was surprised at how cute she is.
188.official: I must say, I was surprised at just how adorable she is.

189.literal: If, heaven forbid, such a cute daughter...
189.official: Such a darling little girl, the thought of someone hurting her must keep you up at night...

190.literal: But... you can't say there aren't people out there who'd do that sort of thing...
190.official: But that doesn't mean that the sort of brute who would hurt a child isn't out there.

191.literal: ...can you? Not in times like these.
191.official: These are frightening times we're living in.

192.literal: [many clubs] had opened here, and the place was thriving.
192.official: At one point, Sotenbori was full of them, and it was a healthy, competitive market.

193.literal: ...and so on, and they swallowed up the other clubs one after another.

194.official: They'd be chompin' at the bit to swallow you up and make that monopoly complete.

195.official: The big-box cabarets like the Grand

196.literal: By defeating those cabarets and taking control of them, they...
196.official: Their aim is to take those cabarets down, and claim that cash, influence, and personnel network for themselves.

197.literal: If they can monopolize [both], they'd effectively control the entire city...
197.official: If they can get the cabaret clubs AND the cabarets, they could have control of the whole city all to themselves.
